profiler.port.description: The loopback port instrumented programs connect to (0: a free port each time IED starts). The Profile task passes it in IED_PROFILER; set it to use a fixed address for programs started outside IED.

profiler.targetFps.description: The frame rate the frame time graph draws its budget line at; frames over the budget are drawn in the warning color, frames over twice it in the error color.

profiler.followLive.description: A live capture's timeline scrolls with the newest data until you zoom or pan.

profiler.ai.model.description: The model the chats asked about a capture run on when they name none: a profile of ai.models, or a version Claude Code offers (claude-opus-4-8). Empty: the default chain (ai.defaultModel). Settings > AI > Defaults sets every use's (docs/04 Defaults by use).

profiler.ai.effort.description: The effort the chats asked about a capture run at when they name none: low, medium, high, xhigh or max. Empty: the model's own (Claude Code says what it is for each model).
